item.title: A chat box is not an agent OS: five places a 30-person company breaks it
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: a chat box on a single-user harness moves the interface and nothing else. The difference is five things — who is speaking, what it remembers, what survives the process, which machine it acts on, and whether the reply arrived. First, the material boundary. The article’s body is behind an X login; what I could read is its own claim plus the opening paragraph.
